about_the_game:
V/V is a is a Precision Platformer where platforms begin to decay as soon as you touch them. This fast paced game has the player racing to restore order to the world as chaos is once again unleashed, and experience a thematic and cyclic story each run. You play as an agent of the Vitality, a force of life and creation, as you work to reseal the Void, a force if death and destruction.

Play in three handcrafted levels of increasing difficulty. Move, Dash, and Jump your way through dangerous terrain to reach the end of each level facing unique challenges in each one.

Level 1: Sky. Navigate through the windy skies as they push you around as you learn the game. This level will be your tutorial and have wind gust mechanics you mist use to get through the level.

Level 2: Canyon. Vultures infused with the chaos around you block your way as you must avoid their strikes. In this level corrupted vultures will attempt to fly at you as you pass by them.

Level 3: Mountain. The frozen mountain pass has you interact with ice and fire lanterns to rebuild or tear down the path before you. In this level you will face puzzle-like mechanics that require you to activate switches to progress. You’ll also encounter wind gusts and vultures from the previous levels.

Built In Speed-running Mode: We know this genre of games appeals to speed runners so we'll have a built in speed-running mode with options to appeal to a speed-running community such as a using a built in split timer and disabling story dialogue.
